objectives:
1. 理解問題解決的邏輯、流程與模型化思維。
2. 學習如何 指揮 AI（ChatGPT、Gemini)定義、分析與解決問題。
3. 建立資料導向（Data-Driven）與模型導向（Model-Driven）的決策思維。
4. 能以創新方式應用AI於學術、職場與社會實務問題。
5.AI 協作與批判思考能力，完成一項AI輔助專案。
content:
1 introduction AI augmented skills
2 Problem defined and identify key issues
3 Leading AI as co-pilot to solve problem
4 Business cases -  financial  analysis
5 Business cases - Operational research
6 Business cases -  Forecadting
7 Business cases -  Developing new product / service
8 Research diagnostic process
9 Individual team for working and lifelong learning
teaching_method:
講授
研討
實習/實驗
grading_policy:
分組作業 50%
出席 10%
